title: Auto Fuel, Sewers & City Greenery
summary:
*   **Embracing the Automotive Age:** Granted a detailed permit for an underground gasoline tank and curbside pump, including specific regulations for safety and lighting.
*   **Investing in Public Health:** Transferred $5,000 to the sanitary sewer fund and approved a new sewer line construction project.
*   **Urban Development & Welfare:** Funded revisions to city ordinances, reallocated park funds for new trees and shrubs, and supported the United Charities Association with relief funding.

Cullen & Caswell
Gasoline Tank

Mayor Wooldridge offered the following resolution : Be it resolved by the City Council of
the City of Austin, Texas : That a permit is hereby granted to the Cullen & Caswell
Autimobile Company to install and maintain a 280 gallon gasoline tank, to be approved by
the Supt of Police and Public Safety ,under the sidewalk in front of Numbers 106 & 112 E
8th street ,in the City of Austin, Texas.
Resolved further:
That in connection with this gasoline tank, hereby authorized to be installed, the said
Cullen & Caswell Autimobile Company is likewise authorized to install ad and maintain a
"Wayne" gasoline pump to be located at the curb line in front of numbers 106-112 E 8'h
street in a position to be desgna ted by the Supt of Street and Public Improvements ,said
gasoline pump to be of the most modern and approved construction and design and subject to
the approval of the Supt of Police and Public Safety.
Resolved further:
That the Cullen & Caswell Autimobile Company shall install and maintain at the tp top of
and upon the gasoline pump hereby authorized, an electric light of not less than 40 watt
power and placed in a globe of not less than ten inches indiameter

hereby authorized to be placed in front of same ,must be kept when not in actual use

herein authorized to be done.
Resolved further and finally:
That this permit is granted only for the installation of a gasoline tank and pump and does
not include the installation or construction of a storage box for hose underneath the
sidewalk and this permit is granted and must be accepted as revocable at any time at the
pleasure of the City Council .
The resolution was adopted by the following vote: Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5 Nays none,
Approved, A P Wooldridge, Mayor.
